verdict.rationale: Thoropass's own materials say it 'connects evidence, progress, and auditors in one place from kickoff to final report' and that every audit step 'happens in one platform.' It also documents audits with evidence requests that take comments, attachments and status updates, plus a Comments Inbox that keeps Control and Evidence Request communication in one page. Together these suggest auditor collaboration replaces email threads, but most of this is marketing-level, and nothing documents a dedicated, permission-scoped auditor role or view. missing for 10: documented scoped auditor role/permissions, description of what the auditor sees and does in-platform, independent or hands-on corroboration of auditors working directly in the platform
